name: Columbus, second voyage
summary: Seventeen ships carry 1,200 settlers to colonize Hispaniola. Columbus finds the Lesser Antilles, Puerto Rico and Jamaica on the way, explores the south coast of Cuba (which he makes his men swear is the mainland of Asia), and begins the enslavement of the Taíno.

stops.note: Seventeen ships, horses, cattle, sugar cane and 1,200 men.
Landfall in the Lesser Antilles after three weeks.
Borikén, the island of the Taíno.
The fort is burned and all 39 men are dead.
The first Spanish town in the Americas.
Xaymaca, explored along its north coast.
Columbus has his crews swear that Cuba is a mainland.
Back to Spain to answer complaints against his rule.
